selector_intents: Execute a detached negative Probe through the S10 behavior selector and observe failure when independent process execution or bound input/output evidence is absent.
Exercise an authorization decision whose only purported authority is historical evidence and require the Toolchain check to reject it.

Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: The compiled detached-Probe execution hint is structurally inspected before Quick Dev authors the planned test. Expected: The emitted hint contains scripts/sc/tests/test_detached_probe_execution.py unchanged in planned_new_files, execution_snapshot_paths, and allowed_write_paths, and represents it as a planned test-author path.
